title: Earth Mantle
description: This mod add 3 new blocks: mantle, peridotite half mantle and peridotite
body: ## Info support: minecraft 1.20.1 ## Description A simple mod that add mantle and ultramafic igneous rocks blocks to minecraft, including layers generation replacing bedrock. ### This mod add 3 new blocks: - Mantle - Peridotite Half Mantle - Peridotite ![3 new blocks](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/2dafcc72207910e78e17f10c53e5ed318dfd3479.png) Stepping on Mantle block will deal damage to the player including tools and armors in their inventory. Holding the Mantle item also do the same. Surrounding block around the Mantle will get convert to Peridotite (except for Mantle, Peridotite Half Mantle, Peridotite, Lava and Magma block). Dropping items into the Mantle will delete them (engulfed into Mantle), if drop more than 32 items they will got convert to lava. (v.0.1.0 Beta and up, on curseforge) Breaking Peridotite or Peridotite Half Mantle will drop 4 Peridotite Fragments which you can craft them into Peridotite. ![peridotite fragments recipe](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/12cc77d907d5ef89a589d71216d07fb16c876e5c.png) (v0.1.1 Beta and up, on curseforge) NOTE: Currently the mod is in development phase, more change will be made in future Roadmap: - more Mantle type blocks - Create compat - Tectonic worldgen compat - Peridotite block variants
